vo.en: You physically cannot lift this finger.

visual.description: Close-up of a man's hand pointing directly at the camera with a slight flex.

vo.en: Put your hands together like this, then fold your middle fingers down so the knuckles touch.

visual.description: Hands coming together in a prayer position then folding the middle fingers inward.

vo.en: Now, try separating your thumbs. Easy. Then your pinkies. Simple. They move because their tendons are independent.

visual.description: Close up of thumbs and then pinky fingers moving freely while the rest of the hand stays locked.

vo.en: Wait until you test this part. Keep those middle fingers locked and try lifting your index fingers.

visual.description: A person struggling to lift their index fingers while their middle knuckles are pressed together.

vo.en: See that? They’re stuck. No matter how hard your brain screams, your index fingers are literally paralyzed.

visual.description: Stylized animation of a human brain with electrical pulses representing signals sent to the hand.

vo.en: This glitch happens because those specific tendons are physically linked together deep inside your hand.

visual.description: 3D anatomical model of a human hand showing the internal tendon structure.

vo.en: Subscribe for more body glitches and comment STUCK if this worked—which is exactly why...

visual.description: Close up of a man's thumb hitting the subscribe button on a phone screen.
